C0873.title: Microsoft Exposes Cryptojacking Campaign Exploiting GPU Mining
C0873.summary: Microsoft's security team uncovered a cryptojacking campaign where attackers distributed malware through poisoned search results, used process hollowing to inject malicious code into Windows system processes, and ultimately deployed GPU mining clients on compromised servers for cryptocurrency mining.
